transitions.operation_detail: Lysis and 72 C denaturation, annealing of the biotinylated oligo-dT30VN and reverse transcription at 42 C (plus 50 C/42 C cycling); the terminal transferase activity of the RT adds non-templated C nucleotides at the cDNA 3' end. Nanolitre reaction volumes under hydrophobic overlay are folded into this step.

Template switching: the rGrGrG 3' end of the Smart-seq3xpress TSO anneals to the non-templated CCC and is copied, appending the complement of the WW spacer, the 8-bp UMI, the 11-bp tag and the partial mosaic-end motif to the cDNA 3' end.

Low-cycle (typically 10-16 cycles) pre-amplification with the forward and reverse PCR primers, generating full-length double-stranded cDNA carrying s5 and mosaic-end sequence at the 5' end. In Smart-seq3xpress the bead clean-up, Bioanalyzer QC and normalisation are replaced by a 10-fold water dilution, folded into this step.

major_reagents.name: Tn5 transposome (Illumina ATM or TDE1, or in-house Tn5)

transitions.operation_detail: Tn5 tagmentation of the diluted pre-amplified cDNA at 55 C followed by SDS release. Each insertion transfers an s5- or s7-mosaic-end strand and leaves a 9-bp gap. Products carrying the same adapter at both ends (s5/s5 or s7/s7) are not amplifiable because of semi-suppressive PCR and are not carried forward; only the mixed-adapter 5'-fragment and internal-fragment products continue.

Index PCR with dual-index Nextera-style primers: 3 minutes at 72 C fills in the 9-bp gap (first cycle), followed by 12-14 amplification cycles that add the P5/i5 and i7/P7 ends. Plate pooling by centrifugation and PEG-bead purification are folded into this step.
Same index PCR reaction as for the 5' fragments: 72 C gap fill-in followed by 12-14 cycles adding P5/i5 and i7/P7, then pooling and PEG-bead purification.
